rule: POLICY: Never deploy to production without a full smoke test suite passing and a rollback plan documented unless the change is a critical security patch with immediate risk mitigation.
POLICY: Always document new public APIs with inline comments and a corresponding README entry unless the API is internal and used only within a single module.
POLICY: Never run untrusted third-party scripts in production environments without sandboxing and prior security review.
POLICY: Always validate user input at the boundary of every service endpoint using schema checks unless the input is strictly internal and trusted.
POLICY: Never leave debugging logs enabled in production builds without explicit approval and a retention policy.
POLICY: Always assign a severity label to every bug report before triage unless it's a known duplicate or low-impact cosmetic issue.
POLICY: Never schedule automated maintenance windows during peak business hours without team-wide notification and stakeholder consent unless it's an emergency patch.
POLICY: Always ensure all code comments are up to date when modifying logic unless the change is a minor refactoring that doesn’t affect behavior.
POLICY: Never assume a feature is complete without integration testing across all dependent services.
POLICY: Always include a changelog entry for every user-facing update unless the change is purely internal or a trivial fix.
POLICY: Never remove a feature flag from the codebase without confirming it has been fully rolled out for at least two weeks.
POLICY: Always run a static analysis pass on every commit unless the change is a documentation-only update.
POLICY: Never ignore test failures during CI runs without a documented rationale and a tracking issue created.
POLICY: Always request a peer review for any change that modifies error handling behavior unless it's a non-critical logging adjustment.
